heroHeadline: Houthis Strike Riyadh Airport for Second Consecutive Day, Killing 1; Dammam Also Hit
heroSubtitle: Saudi Arabia faced a second consecutive day of Houthi missile attacks on King Khalid International Airport, with 1 killed and 11 injured. Dammam's King Fahd International Airport was separately targeted in the same operation, marking a sustained Houthi campaign against Saudi aviation infrastructure.
footerNote: Data sourced from Saudi Press Agency, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, Washington Post, Bloomberg, NBC News, CNN, NPR, ABC News (Australia), TASS, Türkiye Today, Anadolu Agency, News.Az, Yemen Monitor, Arab News, The Hindu, UN OCHA, UN News, World Health Organization, Security Council Report, CFR Global Conflict Tracker, Trading Economics, and the US Senate Armed Services Committee record.
